title: When Boko Haram Learned to Prompt
gist: An Unspent Rounds podcast episode with Antonia Juelich of the Cambridge Programme on AI Science & Policy reports, based on fieldwork in northeast Nigeria, that Boko Haram and other terrorist groups adopted frontier AI faster than most governments, using it for weapons design, tactics, and technical support.

insights.claim: Boko Haram and other terrorist groups picked up frontier AI faster than most governments did.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Faster illicit adoption than states reframes AI misuse as a near-term security problem, not a distant one.
insights.quote: Boko Haram and other terrorist groups picked up frontier AI faster than most governments did
